profile.headline: Agentic Software Engineering “Leadership”
profile.summary:
I am a software enthusiast and technical leader with over ten years of experience spanning numerous roles and settings. From library and API design, to distributed systems, to mobile and web app development, I apply broad expertise to help engineering teams achieve their goals.

I have been a tech lead for multiple teams and projects at Uber/Twitter, as well as leading org-level initiatives. My primary interest is end-to-end product development but I have also worked in product platform and machine learning roles. I have a deep sense of ownership and thrive on the collaboration/mentorship opportunities that come from being part of a team.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Led the development of a Scala-based declarative framework, and accompanying tooling, to help teams efficiently build, maintain, and serve ‘feeds’. Where a feed is a heterogeneous list of something — anything from the Home Timeline to an ML-based candidate generator.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Eats Marketplace
positions.description:
Tech lead on the Eats Marketplace Prediction team, which utilised machine learning to provide accuracy delivery time predictions. Prediction accuracy allows for more efficient delivery scheduling, which in turn improves the unit economics of the business. Responsible for maintaining our model serving service (written in Go) and shepherding changes to models owned by the team.

Notable projects include:

Order Scheduling: identified scheduled orders as not working properly but having huge potential to the business (think grocery/package delivery). I created a roadmap and led the cross-org effort to fix them. This led to better integration in the Eater/Restaurant apps, more accurate predictions, and a higher batch rate.

Restaurant Preparation Time: identified that tighter integration with the Restaurant app could help give us better ground truth on meal preparation times. Led the effort to gather direct signal on 'busyness' and incorporate bluetooth data from the restaurant/driver devices into our prediction models. Substantially increasing our prediction accuracy.
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Python (Programming Language) and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Eater Experience
positions.description: Tech lead for UberEats.com, a Node/React single-page app for online ordering. Planned an executed a year-long effort to re-write the website which resulted in better performance, developer experience, and conversion.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Restaurant Experience
positions.description: Member and later lead (2017+) for the Restaurant Experience team. Led the project to build Uber's first React Native application. It continues to be the main way restaurants accept and track orders on the Eats platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: IMGE is a full-service digital marketing agency located in the Washington, D.C. metro area. I worked on a variety of projects for clients in Node.JS, PHP (Wordpress), Python, and Go.
